key_insight: Weak-AICN extends affine-invariant cubic Newton optimization to weak learners, achieving a global O(1/(Θ̄_k⁴k²)) convergence rate based on average pathwise cosine alignment.
engineering_relevance: The framework provides convergence guarantees for Newton-style boosting and includes Newton coordinate descent as a special case.
method: Use Hessian geometry to measure weak-learner alignment and directional improvement.
Compute a damped weak-Newton step with an explicit stepsize determined by directional improvement δ_k.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical global and local convergence guarantees, including global linear convergence for Hessian-dominated losses, but no empirical benchmarks.
watch_item: The global rate assumes convexity and semi-strong self-concordance, and its practical value depends on weak learners maintaining useful pathwise alignment.
paper_title: Affine-invariant Cubic Newton with Weak Learners
